2Thu Oct 15, 10 AMHeritage Month closes

This is not a month for us.

Heritage Month closes today. Here, it is just how the work gets done, every week of the year.

Support the craft

The proof is in how it is made

El Viejon worked the fields all week and made carne seca by hand on the weekends. Slow, careful, never rushed.

We still do it that way. Trimmed, sliced, marinated, dried and packed by hand. Small batch, zero preservatives, one family.

Nobody makes you do that.

You do it because of who taught you.

Food you are proud to put out

4Thu Oct 22, 6 PMOriginal, for the non chasers

Heat is optional. Flavor is not.

Original is the traditional recipe: salt, ground pepper and spices. No chase, no burn, just carne seca done right.

Try Original

What it actually tastes like

Salt, ground pepper and spices.

That is it, and that is the point.

Dry, meaty and hand sliced, so the beef does the talking instead of a chile hiding it.

When it is the right bag

Long drive, work break, a bag on the counter that everyone picks at.

It is the one nobody at the table hands back.

Want a little something without the fire?

Mild, the step up from Original with flavor and only a hint of heat.

Try Original
